detailed_findings.finding: The nonadjacency argument correctly handles both the left endpoint case j=1 and the general case by deriving contradictory values for the shared sign t_j.
The two biconditional characterizations of odd and even peak sets are proved in both directions with all endpoint cases covered.

reason: The proof correctly and completely establishes all three claimed parts directly from the definition of Peak(t): nonadjacency of peak positions, characterization of the odd peak set by the alternating pattern starting with -1, and characterization of the even peak set by the alternating pattern starting with +1. Edge cases m=1 and small endpoint cases are explicitly handled, and there is no semantic drift from the lemma or its role in the overall argument.
